### The Day of Life at Admission Is Missing or Implausible for a Transferred or Readmitted Infant {#sec-problem-details-24}

For an infant transferred or readmitted to the hospital the day after birth or later, the admission form asks for the infant's day of life on the day of admission, because the platform cannot derive it from the admission date alone; for the other two admission types the platform sets it to 1 itself.
Such an infant is at least one day old when it is admitted, so its day of life at admission is 2 or more.
This message appears in the validation report when the admission form records this admission type but the day of life at admission is missing or below 2.

The value matters beyond the admission form: the day of life recorded on every later form of the enrolment is calculated from it, so a missing or wrong value makes those values wrong or leaves them unchecked.

Please open the admission form (see @sec-solution-15), reopen it for editing if it is completed (see @sec-solution-9) and enter the correct day of life, or correct the admission type if the infant was in fact born in the hospital or admitted on the day of birth.
Afterwards, check whether the day of life values on the enrolment's other forms need to be updated (see @sec-solution-11).
